subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】father 父亲; mother 母亲; grandfather/grandpa 祖父/外祖父; grandmother/grandma 祖母/外祖母; man 男人; woman 女人; sister 姐/妹; brother 兄/弟
【重点句型】Who's that man/woman? 那位男士/女士是谁？ He's/She's my ... 他是/她是我的…… Is she/he ...? 她/他是……吗？ Yes, she/he is. / No, she/he isn't. 是的。/ 不是。 This is my ... 这是我的……
【A Let's talk】Amy: Who's that man? Sarah: He's my father. Amy: Who's that woman? Sarah: She's my mother. Sarah: Hi, Mum! This is my friend, Amy.
【Read and write】This is my family. This is my grandmother. This is my grandfather. This is my father. This is my mother. This is my brother. I love my family.
key_points: Who's that man/woman? 那位男士/女士是谁？
He's/She's my ... 他是/她是我的……
Yes, she/he is. / No, she/he isn't. 是的。/ 不是。
This is my ... 这是我的……
